Cover image, composed like an animated film poster: the child is the subject and FACES THE VIEWER, head and shoulders or waist up, the face large in the frame, eyes looking straight into the camera. One big, exaggerated, instantly readable expression that fits the emotional beat (for example huge wide eyes with raised eyebrows, a dramatic pout with puffed cheeks, an open-mouthed gasp, a jaw-dropped stare, a giant grin). The whole face is visible: never from behind, never in profile, never hidden by hair, hands or objects. A parent may appear only small or soft in the background. This cover framing overrides any wider framing asked for elsewhere in this prompt.

Emotional beat: about to give up, a dramatic pout

Camera: Child eye level, close head-and-shoulders shot, the face large in the lower half of the frame. Lighting: Soft warm afternoon light from a window on the right, a warm lamp glow on the wall.

Cute faces: large round eyes with soft sparkly catch-lights, chubby rosy cheeks, small soft noses and chins; the child has a slightly bigger head relative to the body. Clearly an animated film still, never a photograph. Lived-in Israeli apartment details.

Reserve the top 45% of the frame as clean, quiet negative space (plain warm cream wall above the sofa) for editable Hebrew typography, and keep every face, hand and important object out of that zone.
